definitions.explanation: A large, expensive, and impressive private residence. Emphasizes grandeur and luxury rather than mere size.

examples.english: A mansion stands on top of the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豪邸|ごうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently a famous actor bought a mansion.

examples.japanese: ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪邸|ごうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だった。
examples.english: Living in a mansion with a pool has been my dream since I was a child.

notes:
USAGE:
Always implies wealth and luxury. Often appears in celebrity gossip, real estate features, and lifestyle media. Unlike ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ which simply describes size, {豪邸|ごうてい} conveys impressiveness and opulence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪邸|ごうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to set up a grand residence)
- {豪邸|ごうてい}{暮|ぐ}らし (life in a mansion)
- {億|おく}ション{並|な}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{豪邸|ごうてい} (a mansion rivaling a luxury condo)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{邸宅|ていたく}→邸宅：14434_teitaku⟧: stately residence — formal, slightly more neutral; used in real estate and legal contexts
- ⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧: estate — often implies a large property with grounds, can be old or traditional
